news.headline: Analysts trim price targets after ClearPoint's Q2 miss, though views stay mixed
news.summary: Stifel cut its CLPT price target to $22 from $25 and Lake Street cut to $25 from $30 following the Q2 revenue miss and guidance reduction. Analysts cited caution on near-term FDA/partner-driven revenue timing even while continuing to point to ClearPoint's 60-plus biopharma partnerships as a long-term anchor.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro unveils $500 million long-term revenue target and five-pillar growth strategy
news.summary: Alongside Q2 results, management laid out a five-pillar strategy centered on cell and gene therapy delivery to the brain, targeting $500 million in annual revenue over the long term. The plan highlighted the newly activated ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (CAL) facility and a pipeline of roughly 10 expected partner clinical-trial data readouts over the next 18 months.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro reports Q2 2026 revenue miss, cuts full-year guidance, shares fall
news.summary: Q2 revenue of $10.9 million (up 18% YoY) came in about $1.8 million below consensus, with biologics and drug delivery revenue down 15% on a non-repeating prior-year order; net loss widened to $11.3 million ($0.38/share). CLPT revised FY2026 revenue guidance down to $48-52 million and shares fell over 15% in after-hours trading, ending the period with $29.4 million in cash.

news.headline: CEO signals shift toward a biopharma B2B revenue model
news.summary: On the Q2 earnings call, CEO Joseph Burnett said the company is transitioning its business model, suggesting roughly half of future revenue could come through B2B sales to pharma partners rather than traditional direct device sales. Operating expenses rose 51% year-over-year as ClearPoint invests ahead of anticipated cell and gene therapy commercial launches.

news.headline: Partner Aspen Neuroscience earns FDA RMAT designation for Parkinson's cell therapy
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro congratulated biopharma partner Aspen Neuroscience on receiving FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation for sasineprocel (ANPD001), an autologous dopaminergic cell therapy for Parkinson's disease delivered using ClearPoint's platform. The designation can speed the therapy's regulatory review and adds to ClearPoint's roster of clinical-stage partner programs with expedited pathways.

news.headline: Partner uniQure confirms AMT-130 BLA on track for Q3 2026, guides to 4-year data in September
news.summary: uniQure's Q2 update confirmed its accelerated-approval BLA for Huntington's gene therapy AMT-130 — delivered via ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula and navigation platform — remains on track for Q3 2026 submission, with topline 4-year Phase I/II data expected in September 2026. uniQure also completed a $259 million offering that extends its cash runway into 2030, funding the anticipated commercial launch.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 4-year topline data readout
catalysts.detail: uniQure has guided to topline 4-year follow-up data (24 patients across both dose cohorts) from the Phase I/II AMT-130 Huntington's disease study in September 2026; AMT-130 is delivered using ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula and navigation platform, making this a key read-through for ClearPoint's gene-therapy delivery franchise.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application for AMT-130 under the FDA's accelerated approval pathway in Q3 2026, using ClearPoint's delivery hardware; submission and any subsequent FDA acceptance are near-term catalysts for ClearPoint's platform narrative.

catalysts.label: ClearPoint Neuro Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Based on ClearPoint's historical reporting cadence, Q3 2026 results would be expected in early-to-mid November 2026, providing an update on progress against the revised $48-52 million FY2026 guidance and the CAL biologics services ramp.

catalysts.label: ~10 partner clinical trial data readouts
catalysts.detail: Management guided in its Q2 2026 update to roughly 10 partner biopharma clinical trial data readouts and 10-15 clinical trials using ClearPoint technology enrolling patients over the next 18 months, any of which could move the stock given the platform's B2B exposure to partner pipelines.

catalysts.label: Potential first commercial cell/gene therapy launches on ClearPoint's platform
catalysts.detail: Company commentary tied to regulatory progress across its biopharma partners (including uniQure and Aspen Neuroscience) points to the possibility of the first commercial cell and gene therapies delivered via ClearPoint's platform reaching the market by the end of 2027.

pulse: ClearPoint Neuro's Q2 2026 print disappointed — revenue missed consensus, losses widened, and FY2026 guidance was cut to $48-52 million, sending shares down over 15% and prompting several analyst price-target cuts, even as management unveiled a long-range $500 million revenue ambition built around gene- and cell-therapy delivery. The stock's real swing factor remains its biopharma partner pipeline, above all uniQure's AMT-130 Huntington's program (delivered via ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula), which is on track for a Q3 2026 BLA submission with pivotal 4-year data due in September 2026, alongside partner Aspen Neuroscience's new FDA RMAT designation. Watch September's AMT-130 data readout and execution on the newly activated CAL biologics-services facility as the next tests of whether the B2B, partner-driven growth story can offset near-term device-revenue softness.
